text:
maria: Quick review request  new idea: "spike summary" panel + axis unit pill + smoothing granularity controls. goal: surfacing spikes without compressing the whole chart. thoughts? :mag:

jake: love the idea of a spike summary. mock? curious how it behaves on small panels and in export PNGs

maria: Figma: https://figma.com/file/new/spike-summary-proto (screenshot attached). spike summary is a collapsible row under the chart listing detected spikes with timestamp and short action links (Annotate | Cap)

olivia: accessibility: the spike summary should be keyboard reachable and read by screenreaders when expanded. also the unit pill needs an aria-label that reads the expanded unit ("Units: millions") not just "M"

samir: smoothing granularity thought: three levels  global (toolbar), series-level (legend inline when series focused), and point-level (in spike options). don't force per-point by default.
maria: implementation sketch we prototyped:
```json
{ "yAxis": {"labelMaxLines": 1, "unitPill": {"text": "Units: auto", "ariaLabel": "Units: auto"}}, "legend": {"maxLines": 2, "compact": true, "inlineSeriesControls": true}, "spikeSummary": {"enabled": true, "collapseByDefault": true}, "smoothing": {"levels": ["global","series","point"], "defaultLevel": "global"}}
```
jake: microcopy nit: for the pill prefer "Units: USD" vs just "USD" when axis is ambiguous. For spike summary items use short copy: "Spike • 12.3M — 2026-03-02" and action tooltip "Annotate | Cap"
olivia: a11y for spike markers: do not rely on color. use an outlined diamond + patterned fill for capped points. when focused announce "Spike at 2026-03-02: 12.3 million". spike summary items should also have role="listitem" semantics for VO users.
samir: about export: ensure PNG and PDF exports include the spike summary text when the panel is expanded, otherwise include an alt-text block in the export metadata describing detected spikes. docs will thank us.
maria: good call. add export_alt_text that tools can embed: "Detected spikes: 2026-03-02: 12.3M; 2026-03-06: 9.8M"
jake: keyboard flow: tab order should be legend items -> smoothing global toggle -> spike summary collapsible -> chart canvas. If inline series toggle appears, it should be immediately after the series label in tab order.
olivia: testing: add QA items for keyboard focus size (12px target for spike marker), screenreader announcement tests, and contrast ratio checks for pill background >= 4.5:1 

maria: action list I will file: 1) add unit pill with explicit copy variants and aria-label; 2) spike summary row (collapsible) + per-spike actions; 3) smoothing granularity controls (global/series/point) with clear tab order; 4) export alt-text for spikes and include pill copy in PNG; 5) a11y acceptance tests for keyboard/VO + contrast + non-color markers.
designbot: created ticket #5120: "spike summary panel + unit pill + smoothing granularity" assigned to @maria and @samir.
samir: i'll mock the spike summary interactions and include both annotate & cap flows tomorrow, ping when ready for quick review. :thumbsup:
jake: one last microcopy tweak: spike summary header use: "Spike summary (2)" not "Spikes detected" to keep language tight in small panels
maria: noted  i'll include both header variants in the prototype for A/B. closing thread after prototype upload. :sparkles:
